value.name: Lucia identifies Rosa as source
value.description: Lucia silently confirms to Asha that Rosa was the one involved, revealing the answer before speaking it aloud.
evidence: asked, barely above breath, whether it had been Rosa
the name finally arrived it was Rosa's, said so quietly that Asha felt it more than heard it

value.name: Lucia releases burden of page
value.description: After naming Rosa, Lucia clutches her cardigan as if letting go of something heavier than the page she had been holding.
evidence: Lucia's free hand caught at the cardigan again as if she had let something heavier go than the page itself

value.name: Daniel challenges Lucia's findings
value.description: Daniel calls up the stairwell, questioning whether Lucia found anything useful or is merely guessing.
evidence: Below, Daniel's voice climbed the stairwell, strained at the edges: Asha, just tell us—did Lucia actually find something useful, or is this more of her guessing.

value.name: Asha ignores Daniel's challenge
value.description: Asha refuses to be swayed by Daniel's question and keeps her attention on Lucia.
evidence: Asha kept her eyes on Lucia a moment longer, long enough to let the older woman see that the question in the hall had not moved her

value.name: Asha files page with codicil and statements
value.description: Asha places the folded page beside the codicil and bank statements, aligning the evidence together.
evidence: then slid the folded page in beside the codicil against the bank statements, where the two shaky hands could finally sit on the same side of the argument

value.name: Lucia gives Asha a silver key
value.description: Lucia secretly presses a small silver key into Asha's palm without speaking.
evidence: Lucia's hand went into the pocket of her cardigan and came back closed around something small; she pressed it into Asha's palm without a word
Asha felt the cold tarnish of a silver key against her fingers before she saw it

value.name: Lucia signals hidden lock upstairs
value.description: Lucia silently tells Asha that the rest of the matter is upstairs behind a lock she has been guarding all week.
evidence: Lucia's eyes held hers a beat longer, asking her not to ask yet
and then dropped to the folded page now tucked against the bank statements as if to say the rest of it was upstairs behind a lock she had been guarding all week
